name: Callin
company_or_provider: OWNER_TO_PROVIDE — legal publishing entity that owns/operates Callin
tagline: Explore your voice agents, calls, and transcripts
description: Connect Claude to your Callin account to review voice agents, explore recent inbound and outbound call history, and read call transcripts. Ask natural-language questions about your own call records and use Claude to summarize available transcript text. The connector requests read-only access and cannot place calls, change agent settings, or update billing.
oauth_description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code with mandatory S256 PKCE, dynamic client registration restricted to exact approved redirect URIs (including https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback), resource binding, consent on app.callin.io, refresh rotation, and revocation/disconnect.
icon: See assets/callin-logo-source.png — OWNER must export final icon per Anthropic portal requirements
test_account_instructions: OWNER_TO_PROVIDE — populate a synthetic agent + transcript-bearing call; share credentials securely with Anthropic reviewers only
data_access_explanation: Read-only access to the authenticated user's ai_agents and calls rows (including contact phone numbers and transcript text). No outbound calling, agent mutation, billing, or admin/team-wide access.
installation_instructions: Claude Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → https://claude-mcp.callin.io/mcp → sign in to Callin → Allow
note: Planning metadata only; not an official Anthropic upload manifest. Do not claim submission or approval until completed in Anthropic's portal.
